description: This file contains unit tests for exception safety of absl::variant, including various constructors, assignment operators, emplace, and swap, specifically testing exception guarantees and variant state invariants.

methods.name: ToValuelessByException
methods.description: Forces a variant into the valueless by exception state by emplacing and throwing during conversion.

methods.name: VariantInvariants
methods.description: Checks that the variant maintains its invariants after operations, including active alternative correctness and valueless state.

methods.name: ExpectedThrower
methods.description: Creates a Thrower object with specific arguments for testing.

methods.name: ExpectedThrowerVec
methods.description: Creates a vector of Thrower objects for testing.
